prompt: Complete describeUser so it returns "Hello, <NAME>!" with the name uppercased, or "Hello, guest!" for an empty Optional. Use Optional's map and orElse instead of isPresent and get.
explanation: map applies the lambda only when a value is present, so the greeting is built with the uppercased name; when the Optional is empty, map is skipped and orElse supplies the guest greeting. This single chained expression replaces the isPresent/get pattern, reads as a pipeline, and can never throw NoSuchElementException.
hints: Optional.map transforms the value inside only when one is present; an empty Optional passes through map unchanged.
Inside the map lambda, build the whole greeting string and uppercase the name with toUpperCase.
Finish the chain with orElse("Hello, guest!") so the empty case is handled in the same expression.
